message.reasoning:
We need to generate high-quality unit test code for OneOfValidator.walk covering test cases described. Already some tests exist in framework. Need to add more tests for cases not covered: shouldValidateSchema true returns empty set, cases with no schemas (empty internal list), cases with multiple child schemas (already partly covered but ensure empty set and verify walk called on each), case with child schema throws RuntimeException, case with null node, case with null executionContext.

We must not modify @Before/@After. We can add new test methods.

Need to access internal schemas list? The constructor populates based on schemaNode; we can create validator with empty schemas by passing an empty array node. To test "no schemas configured", we need a validator instance with empty schemas list. Could create new OneOfValidator with empty array node. However constructor signature: OneOfValidator(String path, JsonNode schemaNode, JsonSchema parentSchema, ValidationContext validationContext). So we can pass MAPPER.createArrayNode() empty. That will populate no child schemas.

Testing child schema throws RuntimeException: need to set up child schemas as mocks that throw when walk called. Use same setup: create schemaNode with one child, mock ValidationContext to return mock child that throws. We can create separate validator instance.

Testing null node or null executionContext: need to spy validator and stub validate to throw NullPointerException? The real validate method may still be abstract; but we can spy and stub validate to throw NPE. However description expects that validate (real) will throw NPE; but we don't have real implementation. Safer: spy and stub validate to throw NPE when node is null and verify that walk propagates. Use doThrow.

Implement parameterized tests where appropriate: perhaps for shouldValidateSchema true with non-empty and empty result. Use @ParameterizedTest with MethodSource.

We'll need imports for ParameterizedTest, MethodSource.

Let's write tests.

Test 1: walk_shouldValidateSchemaTrue_returnsValidateResult (already present). Keep.

Add test for true returning empty set: use spy validator, have validate return empty set.

Test for false with no schemas: create validator with empty array node, then call walk false and assert empty set, verify no child walk called.

Test for false multiple child schemas already done but we can produce separate test focusing on verification that validate not called; maybe current test includes spy second call, but might be okay.

Add test for child schema throws exception: set up validator with child that throws when walk called; invoke walk false and assert exception propagates.

Add test for true with null node: spy validator, doThrow NPE when validate called; call walk with node null and expect NPE.

Similarly for null executionContext.

Make sure to use proper mocking.

Let's craft code.
